title: Juicy Glazed Australian Lamb Skewers
description: A festive Australian dish featuring lamb skewers with a mustardy glaze and green salsa, perfect for special occasions. This recipe is also anti-inflammatory-friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, honey, Dijon mustard, garlic, ginger, turmeric, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the lamb skewers for 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the lamb is cooking, prepare the green salsa by stirring it in a bowl.
After the lamb has cooked for 8 minutes, brush the green salsa all over the skewers.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the lamb skewers hot, garnished with additional green salsa if desired.
